module: Flowgraph node "Drift Information" (category repeat_instant, drift). Gives the vehicle's drift state: drifting/notDrifting, pulses spinout, tapped, crashed, donutDetected, tightDriftDetected, driftCompleted (with driftCompletedAddedScore, driftCompletedCachedScore, driftCompletedCombo), and the measurements closestWallDistance, driftAngle, driftVelocity, totalDriftDeg, totalDriftDistance, totalDriftTime, driftUniformity. Source: gameplay_drift_drift.getDriftActiveData and callbacks of the flowgraph drift module.
notes: Outside of drift, the measurements are -1.
driftUniformity is declared but never filled in work.
No general "flow" output is written apart from drifting/notDrifting.
Code todo: tune driftCleanliness, clean up the raycast.

work.desc: Copies the callbacks (ttl > 0) and the active drift data to the output pins.
